name: MONOHA SOURCING INTERNATIONAL
tagline: Connecting Global Opportunities Through Reliable Sourcing & Business Solutions.
intro: MONOHA SOURCING INTERNATIONAL connects businesses with practical sourcing, coordination and business solutions through a structured and professional approach.
description: MONOHA SOURCING INTERNATIONAL works to connect businesses with practical sourcing and operational solutions through structured processes, reliable communication and professional execution.

why.title: Professional Approach
why.text: Every requirement is scoped, documented and handled through the same process.

why.title: Reliable Coordination
why.text: Suppliers, partners and deadlines are tracked and followed up, not left to chance.

why.title: Clear Communication
why.text: One point of contact, and regular updates on where things stand.

why.title: Structured Process
why.text: Seven defined steps from first brief to final delivery.

why.title: Business-Focused Execution
why.text: Options are weighed against your cost, timeline and quality needs.

why.title: Long-Term Perspective
why.text: We work to be the partner you call again for the next requirement.

process.title: Understand
process.text: We listen to the requirement in full — what is needed, by when, and to what standard.
happens: We read your brief and ask the questions needed to make it precise
We agree the specification, quantity, standard and timeline in writing
process.comms: A written summary of your requirement for you to confirm.

process.title: Research
process.text: We study the market and the options before recommending anything.
happens: We study the relevant markets and typical options
We note constraints such as lead times, minimums and standards
process.comms: A short note if research changes the brief or the timeline.

process.title: Source
process.text: We identify suitable suppliers, partners or solutions for the requirement.
happens: We identify suppliers, partners or solutions that fit
We request the information needed to compare them
process.comms: Organised options, with what is confirmed and what is still open.

process.title: Coordinate
process.text: We connect the right parties and keep communication organised.
happens: We keep one record of messages, samples and agreed actions
process.comms: Regular updates at the rhythm agreed at the start.

process.title: Execute
process.text: We carry the agreed plan through, step by step.
happens: We carry the agreed plan through, step by step
We follow up open items before they become delays
process.comms: Status updates, and a prompt message when a decision is needed.

process.title: Review
process.text: We check the work against the original requirement before it is closed.
happens: We check the work against the original requirement
We note anything that differs and agree how to handle it
process.comms: A review summary before anything is closed.

process.title: Deliver
process.text: We hand over the result and stay available for follow-up.
happens: We hand over the result and the records behind it
We stay available for follow-up questions
process.comms: A closing summary, and a point of contact for what comes next.

solutions.title: For Businesses
solutions.text: Sourcing and operational support shaped around day-to-day business needs.
solutions.who: Established businesses that need dependable sourcing or coordination alongside day-to-day operations.
solutions.need: A product, material or supplier needed on a timeline, without pulling your own team away from their work.
solutions.support: We take the requirement off your desk, run it through our process and bring back organised options and regular updates.

solutions.title: For Brands
solutions.text: Product and supplier sourcing that respects your specifications and standards.
solutions.who: Brands developing, refining or re-sourcing products.
solutions.need: Suppliers who can meet a specification and a quality standard consistently.
solutions.support: We turn your specification into a clear brief, shortlist suppliers against it and coordinate samples and feedback.

solutions.title: For Sourcing Requirements
solutions.text: A specific product, material or supplier to find? We scope it and search it out.
solutions.who: Anyone with a specific item, material or supplier to find.
solutions.need: One defined requirement, and someone to search it out properly.
solutions.support: We scope the requirement, research the market and report back honestly on what we find.

solutions.title: For International Partners
solutions.text: Coordination across borders, with one accountable point of contact.
solutions.who: Businesses outside Bangladesh working with partners or suppliers here, and the reverse.
solutions.need: Organised communication and follow-up across distance and time zones.
solutions.support: One accountable point of contact, written summaries and a steady follow-up rhythm.

solutions.title: For Growing Businesses
solutions.text: Structured sourcing support that scales as your volumes and markets grow.
solutions.who: Businesses whose sourcing needs are growing faster than their internal processes.
solutions.need: More structure: documented requirements, tracked progress and fewer loose ends.
solutions.support: We help set up a practical workflow and support your team as volumes and markets grow.

about.who: MONOHA SOURCING INTERNATIONAL is a sourcing and business solutions company. We work between businesses and the suppliers, partners and processes they need, so that requirements are handled in an organised, accountable way.
about.story: Monoha began with a simple observation: businesses lose time and money when sourcing is handled informally. We set out to bring structure, clear communication and responsible follow-up to that work.
about.mission: Our mission is to simplify sourcing and business coordination through reliable processes, professional communication and practical solutions.
about.vision: To build a trusted international sourcing and business solutions company that connects opportunities, businesses and markets through professionalism and long-term relationships.
about.commitment: We commit to honest communication, clear expectations and follow-through on everything we agree to do.

values.title: Professionalism
values.text: Every interaction is handled with care, preparation and respect.

values.title: Reliability
values.text: Deadlines and commitments are treated seriously.

values.title: Clear Communication
values.text: You know where your requirement stands and who to ask.

values.title: Structured Execution
values.text: The same defined process, every time.

values.title: Responsibility
values.text: We own our part of the work, including the follow-up.

values.title: Long-Term Thinking
values.text: We would rather be the partner you call again than the one who promised most.

about.whoMore: We are a young company, and we say so plainly. What we offer is a structured way of working: a written requirement, careful research, organised options, steady coordination and a review before anything is closed.
about.approach: Every requirement moves through the same sequence. It keeps the work predictable for our clients and accountable for us.
